name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: State-directed Russian operations executing kinetic missile assaults against Kyiv's TEC-4 and energy grid, constructing a 100-drone/day Geran-5 base in Millerovo, and repeatedly breaching Moldovan airspace.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Targeted manipulation of commercial supermarket refrigeration and BMS controllers across France, triggering intentional defrost overloads, food spoilage, and isolated electrical fires.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actor UTA0576 and opportunists weaponizing CVE-2026-104935 to bypass authentication and gain root persistence across perimeter gateways, triggering urgent warnings from CISA and NBSZ NKI.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Zero-click targeted advertising exploits operated via Discover-Tech delivering Candiru and mercenary spyware onto high-profile targets across NATO, IAEA, and media institutions.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Large-scale compromise of developer accounts and enterprise code repositories, including Meta GitHub source pools, to exfiltrate proprietary code, CI secrets, and deployment keys.

name: Storm-2990 Global Phishing Kit Syndicate
summary: Chinese-speaking developer syndicate operating commercial phishing suites and living-off-trusted-services infrastructure to compromise enterprise credentials globally.

name: n0n Maritime and Logistics Extortion Wave
summary: Extortion campaign targeting shipping terminal operators and logistics providers via exposed shared enterprise portals, threatening public disclosure of operational EDI message feeds.
